result.query: SELECT json_build_object('active_vpcs',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',vpc_id,'state',state,'reason',reason)) FROM network_vpcs WHERE state<>'deleted'),'active_subnets',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_subnets WHERE state<>'deleted'),'active_eips',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',eip_id,'state',state,'reason',reason)) FROM network_eips WHERE state<>'deleted'),'active_snats',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',snat_id,'state',state,'reason',reason)) FROM network_snat_bindings WHERE state<>'deleted'));
